$comment: The ffmpeg every Premation build ships, and the one the app re-downloads when the shipped copy is missing or broken. ONE pin, read by scripts/fetchFfmpeg.cjs (packaging) and electron/ffmpegRepair.ts (in-app repair), so the two can never disagree. A GPL build on purpose: export uses libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9 and libopus (electron/ffmpegEncodeArgs.ts), none of which an LGPL build has. ffmpeg runs as a separate executable; its licence and source pointer ship beside it (resources/ffmpeg/LICENSE.txt + NOTICE.txt → <resources>/ffmpeg/). Windows and Linux: BtbN's month-end autobuild (kept two years; dailies are kept 14 days, so never pin a daily); the Linux archive is a .tar.xz, which both stagers extract with the system tar. macOS: martin-riedl.de release builds (signed by the publisher). To bump: pick new archives, put their SHA-256 here, and run `node scripts/fetchFfmpeg.cjs --all`. `urls` is a mirror list tried in order; every mirror must serve the identical bytes (the hash is checked).
source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#get-sources (FFmpeg 9.0.2; Windows and Linux build recipe https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, macOS build recipe https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de)
